cushionCut.intro: Enter the ordered size of each cushion. The cuts update as you type.
cushionCut.ruleTitle: How the finished cover is sized
cushionCut.rule: The cover is made 1/4" smaller than the ordered width and depth, and the height is reduced by the deduction you pick (1/2" unless the job says otherwise). Foam is cut to the ordered size.
cushionCut.name: Cushion name
cushionCut.wrapHelp: Zipper wraps halfway around the sides
cushionCut.backHelp: Zipper along the back edge only
cushionCut.frontHelp: The side the zipper runs along
cushionCut.fillIn: Fill in the three sizes to see the cuts.
cushionCut.clearConfirm: Clear every cushion and start over?
cushionCut.nameHelp: Optional. Shows on the cut list and printout.
cushionCut.directionHelp: Pick one if it matters. Decided by the project manager with the client.
cushionCut.fabricHelp: Optional. Enter it on each cushion if they use different fabrics.
cushionCut.jobHelp: These print at the top of the work order PDF.
cushionCut.stripsHelp: Strips are {{len}}" long, cut on the bias from 54" fabric, counted separately for each fabric.
cushionCut.foamNotesPlaceholder: e.g. HD36, layered: 1" soft over 4" firm
cushionCut.foamNotesHelp: For the project manager: foam type, and if it's layered. Foam is cut to the ordered size.
cushionCut.heightDeductionHelp: Usually 1/2". Pick more or less only when the job calls for it.
cushionCut.cordingHelp: Untick if this cushion has no cording.
cushionCut.shape_boxHelp: Box cushion with plates and boxing.
cushionCut.shape_wedgeHelp: Back wedge: deep at the bottom, thin at the top, sloped back rest.
cushionCut.lengthDeductionHelp: Usually 1/2". Only the length is made shorter.
cushionCut.wedgeZipperHelp: Full length, centered on the bottom.

leafBag.intro: Enter each job's finished bag size. The cuts update as you type.
leafBag.rule: Cuts come from the bag size. Both pieces are bag width + 1". Long bottom is bag depth + 9" and short top is bag depth + 2 1/2". Leaf size is for reference only.
leafBag.pasteHelp: Copy the rows (Job #, Leaf Width, Leaf Depth, Bag Width, Bag Depth, Qty) from the spreadsheet, paste them here, then press Add rows.
leafBag.jobHelp: Prints on the cut list and labels.
leafBag.fillIn: Fill in the bag width and depth to see the cuts.
leafBag.clearConfirm: Clear every bag and start over?

cushionPricing.intro: Enter each section's size. Prices for every labor and insert option show as you type. Prices are per piece.
cushionPricing.addOns: Throw pillow labor {{pillow}} each · Welting +{{welt}} per piece · Outdoor Celeste Bio tick +{{tick}} per piece · COM: labor × 1.15. Tick add-ons on each section to include them in the quote.
cushionPricing.pasteHelp: Copy the rows (Name, Qty, Length, Seat Depth, Seat Thickness, IB Height, IB Thickness), paste them here, then press Add rows.
cushionPricing.name: Name
cushionPricing.fillIn: Fill in the length and at least the seat or inside back sizes to see prices.
cushionPricing.quoteHelp: Each section's labor, inserts and add-ons are priced above. Price each is seat + inside back; total is × how many.
cushionPricing.clearConfirm: Clear every section and start over?
cushionPricing.copied: Copied. Paste it into Estimate Rocket.
cushionPricing.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it instead.
cushionPricing.yardsEach: {{n}} yd each (exact {{exact}}), rounded up to whole yards
cushionPricing.addOnsHelp: Ticked add-ons are added to this section's price. Per piece = seat and inside back each.
cushionPricing.addTick: Outdoor Celeste Bio tick (+{{price}} per piece)
cushionPricing.fabricEachMany: Yards each are listed per section above

upholstery.intro: Follows "How to price upholstery labor": base labor, cushions, foam, yardage, supplies, then upcharges. The estimate at the bottom lists each line the way you enter it in QuickBooks.
upholstery.newConfirm: Clear this estimate and start a new one?
upholstery.oversizeNone: No oversize charge for this type
upholstery.noSlip: No slipcover price is listed for this type, so upholstery labor is used.
upholstery.noCushions: No cushions. Add one if the piece has loose cushions.
upholstery.cushionYards: Add cushion fabric to yards required
upholstery.cushionYardsWarn: The chart's approximate yardage may already include cushions. If it does, untick "Add cushion fabric" so they aren't counted twice.
upholstery.yardsHint: Piece {{piece}} yd + cushions {{cushions}} yd = {{total}} yd charged (whole yards). Leave blank to use the chart.
upholstery.fabricPriceHelp: Leave blank if the client supplies the fabric
upholstery.suppliesNote: Upholstery supplies use the same quantity as the yardage.
upholstery.white: White fabric: add {{pct}}% to total labor
upholstery.ratesHelp: Cushion and foam rates match the Cushion Pricing calculator; supplies matches the QuickBooks item. Saved on this device.
upholstery.copied: Copied. Paste into QuickBooks or your notes.
